title: Packaged terminal-accept path fails deterministically in the current two-display desktop; independent of the W30 repair
owner_wave: UNRESOLVED - the packaged smoke self-report path lives in src/hpc_gui/wx_shell.py (run-phase-accepted evidence code); the controller must assign the stable owner. It is NOT W57-owned and NOT the W30 repair.

harness.note: The maintained W04 harness was executed unmodified in every run below, at its default budget.

runs.product: PRE-repair (the W30 change reverted, same tree otherwise)
post-W30-repair, harness console window minimised via Start-Process -WindowStyle Minimized

discriminating_experiment.question: Is the packaged-gate red caused by the W30 closed_owner_repair, or by the execution environment?
discriminating_experiment.method: The W30 repair was reverted in the product file only (src/hpc_gui/services/job_submit_cancel.py), the candidate was rebuilt with the identical maintained build path (.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m PyInstaller -y --clean build/windows/hpc-client-gui.spec) and the unmodified harness was re-run twice.
discriminating_experiment.result: The pre-repair build F904FAAF fails the IDENTICAL 6 checks with the IDENTICAL runtime diagnostic. The red is therefore NOT attributable to the W30 repair and NOT to anything W57 changed.
discriminating_experiment.build_size_control: pre-repair build = 7672516 bytes, exactly the size of the previously declared CAA5904A candidate; post-repair build = 7672468 bytes. The 48-byte delta is the removed 2-line gate. The build is not bit-reproducible (PE timestamps), so identical product bytes yield a different SHA-256 on each build.

mechanism.code_path: src/hpc_gui/wx_shell.py:2226-2375. The smoke child raises its frame, claims foreground with SetForegroundWindow (accepted; wx_shell.py:2296 check passes), reads the xterm DOM focus, then positions the real cursor at the centre of the WebView via panel._webview.ClientToScreen and injects a synthetic left click with SendInput. Immediately afterwards wx_shell.py:2373 re-reads GetForegroundWindow, it is no longer the frame, and the run finishes with keyboard_input:foreground_lost_after_terminal_click. Because the click never lands, every downstream input and round-trip stage cascades.
mechanism.environment_measurement: Two displays are attached to the active console session: \\.\DISPLAY1 primary at X=0 1920x1080 and \\.\DISPLAY4 secondary at X=1920 1920x1080; virtual desktop 3840x1080. The foreground window at measurement time was the harness's own Python console.
mechanism.hypothesis: ClientToScreen/SetCursorPos coordinate handling for a WebView host on a non-primary display is the failing link: the synthetic click lands on a window other than the packaged frame, so foreground moves away and the smoke run aborts. This is consistent with 6/6 deterministic reproductions and with the prior run's four 20/20 green runs, which the earlier report did not record alongside a display change.
mechanism.confidence: The environment difference is measured and the product independence is proven. The precise Win32 cause inside the click path is a hypothesis, not a proven root cause, and is stated as such.

release_decision: DEFER as P2 with the packaged gate recorded as RED. This is not a product regression and not a W57 defect: it reproduces identically on a build that excludes the W30 repair. It is also not a human deferral - the two next actions are bounded and machine-executable. The gate stays red in this report; no 20/20 is claimed and the prior CAA5904A green evidence is preserved unmodified and explicitly not reused for this candidate.
next_actions: Controller/owner: assign the stable owner for the packaged smoke terminal-accept path in src/hpc_gui/wx_shell.py and decide whether the click path must be made multi-display safe (DPI-awareness manifest verification, or refusing to rely on a synthetic click when the webview is not on the primary display).

Operator: re-run the unmodified harness on a single-display session, or on a session where the packaged frame is the only top-level window, to separate the environment contribution from any product contribution. This is a measurement action, not a substitute for the owner decision.
